name: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Interactive floating Tic-Tac-Toe mini-game with local 2-Player mode and intelligent AI opponent.
longDescription:
Bring playful entertainment into your PDF workflow! Features single player vs AI (with Easy, Smart, and Unbeatable difficulties) and local 2-player pass-and-play mode. Deeply integrated with FryPDF shell overlay, status bar, and command palette.

### Key Features:
• **Floating Shell Overlay**: Smoothly drags and docks on top of any document workspace.
• **Single Player vs Smart AI**: Multiple difficulty settings with strategic minimax moves.
• **Local 2-Player Mode**: Play head-to-head with friends or colleagues.
• **Score Counter**: Live score tracking for wins, losses, and draws.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Command Palette, Status Bar, and Ribbon View Tab.
contributedFeatures: Shell Overlay: Floating Tic-Tac-Toe Game Card
Status Bar: Clickable '🎮 Tic-Tac-Toe' Indicator Pill
Ribbon: View Tab > Plugins > Tic-Tac-Toe Action Button

name: Retro Arcade Snake Game
description: Playable, draggable retro-arcade Snake game floating over the application canvas in the 'shell.overlay' slot.
longDescription:
Bring playful retro-arcade entertainment into your document workflow! This extension mounts a high-performance floating Snake game into the 'shell.overlay' slot.

### Key Features:
• **Non-Modal Floating Overlay**: Runs smoothly on top of any document or workspace page without interrupting your PDF work.
• **60+ FPS Smooth Avalonia Drawing**: Direct DrawingContext GPU rendering with zero Large Object Heap allocations.
• **Tactile Custom Chrome Frame**: Dark retro arcade aesthetics with D-Pad and score counters.
• **Interactive Controls**: Keyboard arrows/WASD, on-screen tactile D-Pad buttons, difficulty & speed selection.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Command Palette, Status Bar, and Ribbon View Tab.
contributedFeatures: Shell Overlay: Floating Snake Game Card
Status Bar: Clickable '🐍 Snake' Indicator Pill
Ribbon: View Tab > Plugins > Snake Game Action Button

name: Review Scratchpad & Notes
description: Floating Markdown scratchpad with live word/char counters and timestamp logs for PDF review.
longDescription:
Jot down rapid review notes, citations, page corrections, and checklists without leaving your current PDF screen.

### Key Features:
• **Automatic M3 Expressive Card Chrome**: Automatic draggable header, pin toggle, and minimize pill.
• **Live Word & Character Counter**: Keep track of notes and summary length in real time.
• **Quick Action Pills**: One-click timestamp insertions and notes clearing.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Command Palette (`Ctrl+Alt+N`), Status Bar (`📝 Notes`), and Ribbon View Tab.
contributedFeatures: Status Bar: Clickable '📝 Notes' Indicator Pill
Ribbon: View Tab > Plugins > Scratchpad Button

name: Document Telemetry HUD
description: Live performance telemetry HUD showing managed heap allocation, GC cycles, and memory trimming.
longDescription:
Monitor runtime engine health, managed memory, GC generations, and system architecture in a compact floating HUD.

### Key Features:
• **Real-Time Memory Telemetry**: Track managed heap size and GC frequency.
• **One-Click Heap Trimming**: Trigger immediate memory compaction and trimming during heavy PDF sessions.
• **Compact Floating Utility**: Stays parked neatly on top of the document workspace without obstructing tools.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Command Palette (`Ctrl+Alt+T`), Status Bar (`⚡ HUD`), and Ribbon View Tab.
contributedFeatures: Shell Overlay: Floating Telemetry HUD Card
Status Bar: Clickable '⚡ HUD' Indicator Pill
Ribbon: View Tab > Plugins > Telemetry HUD Button
